chained_from: proj_fully_fused (a byte-identical copy of the radii/means2d/depths fwd goldens, seed 7)
key_encoding: isect_id(u64) = image_id << (32+tile_n_bits) | tile_id << 32 | f32bits(depth); tile_id = tile_y*tile_width + tile_x; tile_n_bits = bits_for_count(tile_width*tile_height), image_n_bits = bits_for_count(I). SXT does not support int64 → stored split into int32 lo (low 32 bits = the depth f32 bits reinterpreted) and hi (high 32 bits = image|tile) (D3).
note: torch _isect_tiles covers only the AABB fallback path (07 Correction 2) — it is not an AccuTile (conics/opacities) golden. The Metal isect kernel is verified under the AABB contract (conics/opacities not passed). isect_ids_lo/hi and flatten_ids are the raw output in emit order (2-pass pass2), and *_sorted are the sorted goldens. The keys of this fixture contain no ties (asserted) — stable-sort verification under ties is isect_ties. All tensors are compared exact (int/bit).
sort_contract: Ascending **stable** sort on the ulong(u64) key (the sort contract, 03). The golden is np.lexsort((lo,hi)) — the equivalence baseline is the CPU std::stable_sort(ulong key). torch.sort is not used (stability is not guaranteed).
